from itertools import permutations
import numpy as np
data=[]
for p in ps:
    cnt=[0]*10
    for r in p['input']:
        for v in r: cnt[v]+=1
    O=np.array(p['output'])==8
    data.append((cnt,O))
preds={
 'odd': lambda c: c%2==1,
 'even': lambda c: c%2==0,
 'c==1': lambda c: c==1,
 'c==2': lambda c: c==2,
 'c<=2': lambda c: 0<c<=2,
 'c<=3': lambda c: 0<c<=3,
 'c>0': lambda c: c>0,
 'c>=3': lambda c: c>=3,
 'prime': lambda c: c in (2,3,5,7),
}
for pname,f in preds.items():
    for colors in [tuple(range(1,10)), tuple(range(0,9)), tuple(range(1,10))[::-1], tuple(range(0,9))[::-1]]:
        ok=True
        for cnt,O in data:
            M=np.array([[f(cnt[colors[3*i+j]]) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)])==True
            if not (M==O).all(): ok=False;break
        if ok: print(pname, colors)
print('done')
